name: dns-mock
description: A DNS and DNS-over-HTTPS filtering resolver: declared records, declared blocked names, every query an event.

settings.name: doh_http_status
settings.description: HTTP status the DoH endpoint answers with; 200 returns the DNS answer, anything else is an injected HTTP-level failure with no DNS answer.

settings.name: latency_ms
settings.description: Milliseconds every answer is held back, on every transport.

settings.name: servfail
settings.description: Every query is answered SERVFAIL, whatever is declared.

settings.name: drop_udp
settings.description: Queries over UDP get no answer at all, so a client retries over TCP or times out. TCP and DoH are unaffected.

settings.name: records
settings.description: JSON array of records: {"name","type" (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX),"value","ttl" (optional, default 60)}. Names lie under example.test or acme-example.test; A values in 192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24 or 203.0.113.0/24; AAAA in 2001:db8::/32; an MX value is "<preference> <host>".

settings.name: blocked
settings.description: JSON array of blocked names under example.test or acme-example.test; a blocked name and every name below it is answered as block_answer says, before any record is consulted.

settings.name: block_answer
settings.description: How a blocked name is answered: NXDOMAIN, REFUSED, or the sinkhole_ip address.

settings.name: sinkhole_ip
settings.description: The address a blocked name resolves to when block_answer is sinkhole; from 192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32.
